YearEnd.title: Year-end
YearEnd.subtitle: Service charge, depreciation, dividend and profit appropriation — in this order. The last step closes the year's books.
YearEnd.adminNote: You can follow the status here. Only the super admin can run the year-end steps.

banner.closed: This year's books are closed (up to {date}). Its entries can no longer change.
banner.open: The year has ended and its books are still open. Run the steps below in order.
banner.notEnded: This year is still running. Its year-end can start the day after {date}.

stepBody.service_charge: The yearly service charge is taken from every member's Amanot. If the balance is short, the rest stays due and is taken from their next Amanot deposit automatically.
stepBody.dividend: The committee's amount is shared among active members (by Amanot + Fixed Amanot) and added to their Amanot.
stepBody.appropriation: The year's net profit is split into the funds. Then the year's books close.

blocked.notEnded: Can run once the year ends

lines.search: Search by member no. or name

figures.dividendRules: Rules: under <threshold></threshold> deposited this year gets at most <cap></cap>; nobody gets more than <max></max>.

runDescription.service_charge: Every entry is dated {lastDay}. Check the figures below, then run.
runDescription.dividend: Enter the committee's total and preview. Every entry is dated {lastDay}.
runDescription.appropriation: Check the year's income, expense and the fund split. Running it closes the books up to {lastDay}.

done.service_charge: The service charge for {fiscalYear} is done.
done.dividend: The dividend for {fiscalYear} has been added to members' Amanot.
done.appropriation: The profit for {fiscalYear} is appropriated and the year is closed.

dividend.amountHint: Enter the amount and press "Preview". Nothing is saved.
dividend.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above 0, at most 2 decimals

appropriation.problemsTitle: Some fund heads are not set
appropriation.problemsBody: On the heads page, give the fund heads their "year-end role" (reserve, co-operative development, welfare, undistributed profit), then open this again.

warning.service_charge: Running this adds an entry to every member's passbook. It can't be undone.
warning.dividend: Running this adds the dividend to every member's Amanot. It can't be undone.
warning.appropriation: Running this moves the profit into the funds and closes this year for good. No entry of this year can be added or reversed afterwards.

YearEnd.confirm: I have checked the figures and want to run it

depreciation.cardBody: Lower the value of assets like land, buildings or furniture. No cash moves; it counts as an expense of the year. Enter it before the profit appropriation.
depreciation.none: No depreciation entered for this year.
depreciation.title: Depreciation · {fiscalYear}
depreciation.description: Lower one asset head's value. It can't be more than the head's current balance.
depreciation.head: Asset head
depreciation.noHeads: There is no open asset head with a balance.
depreciation.hint: Without a description it reads "<head> অবচয়". A wrong entry is reversed from Samiti entries.

validation.head: Choose a head
validation.amountFormat: Enter an amount above 0, at most 2 decimals
validation.dateFuture: The date can't be in the future

YearEndErrors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
YearEndErrors.notEnded: {fiscalYear} ends on {date}. Its year-end can run from the next day.
YearEndErrors.alreadyFinal: The books of {fiscalYear} are already closed.
YearEndErrors.finishEarlier: Finish the year-end of {fiscalYear} first (next step: {kind}).
YearEndErrors.alreadyRun: The {kind} for {fiscalYear} has already been run.
YearEndErrors.netLoss: {fiscalYear} ended with a net loss. There is no rule for appropriating a loss yet, so this can't run.
YearEndErrors.missingFundHead: Not every fund head is set. Give the fund heads their "year-end role" on the heads page.
YearEndErrors.dividendNotRun: The dividend for {fiscalYear} has not been paid yet.
YearEndErrors.runNotFound: The {kind} for {fiscalYear} has not been run yet.
